description: Sends a pause, resume, or cancel command for one active download and returns an immediate local state observation.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose download should be controlled.

purpose.description: Describe why you are changing the download state, e.g., pausing until network recovery

downloadId.description: Opaque download record ID controlled by this action.

requestedCommand.description: Lifecycle command requested by the caller.

previousState.description: Download state observed locally before the command was sent.

currentState.description: Download state observed locally immediately after the command was sent; this is not guaranteed to be final.

changed.description: Whether the local observed lifecycle state changed; this does not confirm native completion.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

previousState.description: Download state observed locally before the command was sent.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
